يحتوشن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَوِشْنَ (yaḥtawišna) /jaħ.ta.wiʃ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# يُحْتَوَشْنَ (yuḥtawašna) /juħ.ta.waʃ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
